name: The Pariah's Instructions

guaranteedRewards.name: Mark of the Chosen
tooltip: Equip: Has a 2% chance when struck in combat of increasing all stats by 25 for 1 min.

narrative.details:
Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe.

The task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter.

If you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.
narrative.objectives: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This is it, friend! This is it! Now I can begin the great task of uniting the tribes. Thank you.

Take this for your efforts, please. I hope when next we meet, it will be on much different terms.
narrative.requestItemsText: What did you decide, adventurer? Can you help me? Will you set foot on holy ground to help me forge one great centaur tribe!?
